state.normalizedUnderstanding: The user is comparing DSC and ASL perfusion MRI in glioma patients. They want to determine which modality is more useful for assessing tumor progression when DSC and ASL findings are discordant. Additionally, patients with only ASL data should preferably be retained in the cohort if possible.
